"渋谷へ" refers to the destination "Shibuya," with "へ" indicating the direction or destination. "は" is the topic particle, marking Shibuya as the topic of the sentence. "どこで" means "where" in the context of a location or action, and "乗り換える" (nori kaeru) means "to transfer" or "to change trains." "んですか" is a polite way to ask for an explanation or information, often used to seek clarification.
